The CMake build uses these pinned upstream sources directly and does not download dependencies.

| Dependency | Version | Upstream |
| --- | --- | --- |
| cpp-httplib | v0.35.0 | [Release](https://github.com/yhirose/cpp-httplib/tree/v0.35.0) |
| nlohmann/json | v3.12.0 | [Release](https://github.com/nlohmann/json/tree/v3.12.0) |
| Nayuki QR Code generator | v1.8.0 | [Release](https://github.com/nayuki/QR-Code-generator/tree/v1.8.0) |
| miniz | 3.1.0 | [Release](https://github.com/richgel999/miniz/tree/3.1.0) |

The upstream license files are included alongside the sources. Nayuki includes the MIT license in its upstream README and both source files.
